race.title: Midnite It's Actually Pretty Good Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
race.verdict: The unexposed MERCI MONSIEUR opened his account on reappearance last time and can quickly double up now handicapping. Politely has worked her way back to form for her new yard and should go close again, while Duke's Command can't be ignored from his current mark. MERCI MONSIEUR (GER) POLITELY DUKE'S COMMAND
race.bettingForecast: Merci Monsieur (9/4), Politely (3/1), Caledonian (7/1), Velvet Vega (8/1), Wyld Bill (10/1), Duke's Command (10/1), Gilet (10/1), Francesi (12/1), Crack On Boys (25/1)
